title: Space Bash — Orbital Breakfloor
description: A self-contained 2–10 contestant physics survival arena with throwable crates, TNT/Nitro, destructible floor tiles, mobile multi-touch controls and bot-filled solo play. Source is imported; phone room-code multiplayer is not integrated.

source.provenance: User-directed original standalone HTML implementation developed in this ChatGPT project. The imported v1.13.1 build is self-contained Canvas 2D/JavaScript with procedural visuals and audio; no third-party game code, artwork, music, or binary assets are included.
